About El Castillo
An icon in the area
The Castle — a magnificent mansion perched 300 feet above the Pacific, with arguably the most dramatic view in all of Costa Rica.
Classic
Built to withstand the test of time
When El Castillo's land was purchased, it was one of the most sought-after properties in South Pacific Costa Rica — the last frontier of untouched land, on a cliff between two national parks: Corcovado and Ballena.
The hotel was built like a fortress, taking a full year to complete. It has become an icon in the area, beloved by local ex-pats from around the world and native Costa Ricans alike for its stunning views.

Our People
Meet the team
With a one-to-one staff-to-room ratio, our small team is the heart of El Castillo. Guests remember them long after the tan fades — anticipating your needs before you even know you have them.
One family
The people who make it El Castillo
From the kitchen to the bar, housekeeping to your host, every member of our team lives nearby in Ojochal and treats the hotel as their own home — welcoming you into it.
It's this warmth, more than any single view or detail, that guests tell us they remember most.

Yostin Muñoz
Leads Castillo's Kitchen, crafting an ever-evolving take on Costa Rican cuisine from fresh, local ingredients.

At Your Service

Anticipates every need — from the perfect table to the best of Ojochal beyond our gates.
Housekeeping
The Art of Comfort
Refreshes every room daily with crisp linens and a spotless finish — the quiet care you feel the moment you walk in.
Heaven on earth
Spectacular, yes. Stuffy, no.
El Castillo — The Castle — sits in Ojochal, in the Central Southern Pacific region of Costa Rica known for its culinary excellence. There's a reason it's named The Castle: perched 300 feet above the ocean, it commands a view like nowhere else.
Our exceptional staff, at a one-to-one ratio, will ensure your vacation is the greatest of your lifetime. For your convenience, we also offer private transportation from the international airport — please contact our reservation advisors before your trip to arrange it.

El Castillo Arranged Adventure
Snorkel Caño Island
A full day in the water at one of the most pristine marine reserves in the country.
The experience
Crystal water, turtles & reef
Caño Island Biological Reserve sits offshore from the Osa Peninsula, ringed by some of the clearest water and healthiest reef in Costa Rica. After a scenic boat ride you'll slip in among sea turtles, rays, reef fish, and — if you're lucky — white-tip reef sharks.
It's a full-day outing with a certified guide, gear, and time to simply float in the blue. Bring a swimsuit and reef-safe sunscreen; we'll take care of the rest.
